description: Create and update MoEngage users, track their events, build segments, send push notifications and API-triggered messages, manage campaigns, flows and email subscriptions, and follow new and sent campaigns, flows and segments.

moengage_campaign_sent_trigger.description: Runs when a push or email campaign finishes sending.

output.campaign: The record returned by the service

moengage_campaign_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a campaign made in the last 30 days is published, scheduled, paused, sent, stopped or archived.

output.campaign: The record returned by the service

moengage_flow_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a flow is published, paused, resumed, stopped, completed or retired.

output.flow: The record returned by the service

moengage_new_campaign_trigger.description: Runs when a push or email campaign is created, drafts included.

output.campaign: The record returned by the service

moengage_new_flow_trigger.description: Runs when a flow (a multi-step journey) is created.

output.flow: The record returned by the service

moengage_new_segment_trigger.description: Runs when a custom segment is created.

output.segment: The record returned by the service
